main_body: red theater armchair with backrest and seat cushion
top_band: 1px pink highlight rim at row 2 on the backrest; the lower section (rows 10-12) is only 3 rows of cushion shaded identically to the vertical backrest (left-to-right gradient) with no front face below it other than a 1px dark outline and 1px legs
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 2 is a 1px pink top rim, rows 3-8 are the vertical backrest face, row 9 is a 1px dark dividing line, rows 10-12 are a 3px lower panel/cushion with the exact same vertical side-lit shading as the backrest, row 13 is a 1px bottom outline, and row 14 has 1px feet. Neither the backrest nor the seat shows a foreshortened top surface plus a distinct vertical front face; it reads as a flat front elevation of a chair.

style.evidence: The red upholstery uses 4-5 maroon/pink tones and a dark maroon outline (dark_material_tone), with 2 brown tones for the armrests/legs. However, the shading is simple blocky vertical bands with large flat areas and lacks the fine surface texture and structural richness of the Beodeul references.
